description: This file defines a singleton object StringUtils that provides utility functions for string operations, specifically join and split, which internally delegate to other utility classes.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing string manipulation methods such as join and split.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins elements of a LinkedList into a String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using SplitUtils.
